instruction_evidence.quote_zh: 途中左侧经过一个装饰架，右侧经过一排木衣柜

instruction_evidence.quote_en: Go through the doorway into the tiled hallway
instruction_evidence.quote_zh: 穿过门洞进入铺砖走廊

description.zh: F5和F6显示白色洗手池与镜子；F16显示磨砂玻璃门或隔断，表明机器人从盥洗区域向玻璃门附近移动。
description.en: F5 and F6 show a white sink and mirror; F16 shows a frosted glass door or partition, indicating movement from the wash area toward the glass door.

description.zh: F26和F37显示木地板房间，装饰架位于左侧，成排木衣柜位于右侧，与任务描述的空间关系相符。
description.en: F26 and F37 show the wooden-floor room with the decorative stand on the left and the row of wooden wardrobes on the right, matching the spatial relationships described in the task.

description.zh: F47和F48显示接近白色门框和墙面，B处镜面反射出木地板和门洞，但未清楚显示铺砖走廊。
description.en: F47 and F48 show proximity to a white doorframe and wall; at B the mirror reflects the wooden floor and doorway, but the tiled hallway is not clearly shown.

semantic_progress.zh: 截至S02，已从白色洗手池和镜子区域移动到木地板房间内，画面显示装饰架在左侧、成排木衣柜在右侧，路线与任务描述的房间和参照物关系相符；随后接近白色门框和镜面区域，尚未确认已穿过门进入铺砖走廊，也未确认走廊内绿色装饰、小门洞及圆形木饰。
semantic_progress.en: As of S02, the robot has moved from the white sink and mirror area into the wooden-floor room; the decorative stand is on the left and the row of wooden wardrobes on the right, consistent with the room and object relationships described in the task. It then approached a white doorframe and mirror area; it is not yet confirmed whether the doorway into the tiled hallway has been crossed, nor have the green decoration, smaller doorway, and round wooden art piece in the hallway been confirmed.

uncertainties.zh: B处镜面和白色台面是否仍位于木地板房间或门框附近，以及是否已经穿过敞开门进入铺砖走廊，尚不能由F47和F48确定。
uncertainties.en: Whether the mirror and white surface at B are still in the wooden-floor room or near the doorway, and whether the open doorway into the tiled hallway has been crossed, cannot be determined from F47 and F48.

uncertainties.zh: 任务后续要求的走廊右侧绿色装饰、左侧小门洞和圆形木饰均未在本段得到确认。
uncertainties.en: The later required tall green decoration on the right, the smaller doorway on the left, and the round wooden art piece in the hallway are not confirmed in this segment.
